The wood grain on several planks appears slightly smeared or painterly rather than having sharp, distinct fibrous details. Some edges of the planks blend softly into the floor.
The inclined conveyor belt's support structure has inconsistent perspective lines. Some supports appear to vanish into the background without connecting to the floor or ceiling logically.
